status: EXPLORATORY (docs/12 F23): early concept test of the self-supervised clause banks (conceptualization challenge C1). Not pre-registered; no docs/13 threshold is tested. The early verdict rule was fixed on 2026-09-24. Validation-free: no WikiText-103 validation or test data is read; the WikiText-103 test split is never loaded. Downstream sets: SimLex-999 and WordSim-353 have no official split (all pairs read, every run counted as an access), MEN: the dev split only.

phases.bank: one run per bank (trained, young, epoch1): count pass over the prefix on the GPU, the three profiles, all variants, pair similarities and neighbour lists saved as reps_<bank>.npz
phases.baselines: one run: co-occurrence families on the same prefix (and one on the full train split), CBOW, exchange codes, a frequency control, saved as reps_baselines.npz
phases.evaluate: one run over the saved representations: Spearman with bootstrap intervals, the early verdict, WordNet purity, printouts

data.train_prefix: first 20,000,000 tokens of the train split cut at a document boundary (m3_tiny_lm.slice_train), as experiments/cvtm_t1_readout.py
data.counting_positions: positions of the prefix outside the fit documents of docs/11 11.6 (splitmix64(i XOR 0xC0FFEE) mod 100 == 0), exactly the counting positions of the T1 read-out

trained.note: causal V 8000, C 1,048,576, 4 epochs of TA feedback on the 135M-token train split

young.note: the same engine config and batch order, stopped when 98 percent of the clauses were alive: 10,487 batches, 0.079 epoch of TA feedback (the untrained control)

epoch1.note: optional learning-curve point (1 epoch of TA feedback); run only when the budget allows

primary.rule: fixed before any number existed; the pre-declared single variant of every count-based family

baselines.cooc_prefix_targets: the counting positions of the prefix (contexts may be any position of the same document)
baselines.ppmi_svd_reference: family cooc20M_* with scheme ppmi and an svd reduction: the PPMI-SVD reference of the early verdict (same tokens as the bank counts)

cbow.note: in-house CBOW, dim 128, window 5, 1 epoch of the full train split

baselines.exchange: kind_map rows 1..3 of data/wikitext103/bpe8000/train (3-level 16-way exchange clustering of train bigrams); similarity = number of shared levels
baselines.frequency_control: similarity = -|ln f(a) - ln f(b)| with f the train-split token frequency (sym_freq): how much of a score frequency alone explains

coverage_rule: a pair counts when both words are ONE BPE-8k token in the mid-sentence form ' word' (as given; for WordSim-353 the lower-cased word is tried when the given case is not one token)

wordnet.labels: for every word-like token (' ' + lower-case ASCII letters, at least 3): the lexicographer file (supersense) and the part of speech of its first synset, and the set of all its synsets; tokens without a synset are not eligible

verdict.GO: the trained bank's best representation beats the young bank's best by at least 0.05 Spearman AND is within 0.05 of, or above, the best PPMI-SVD (prefix co-occurrence, ppmi, svd)
verdict.NO_GO: the trained bank's best representation does not beat the young bank's best
robustness_views: best over the same grid (the rule of the design; in-sample maximum, selection bias shared by both banks)
the pre-declared primary variant (count profile, ppmi, svd300_p0.5)
variant chosen per family on WordSim-353 + MEN dev (mean Spearman), then read on SimLex-999
